fields.name: Giant Rat
fields.tell: bares its yellow teeth and crouches to spring

fields.name: Goblin
fields.tell: shrieks and lifts its rusty cleaver over its head

fields.name: Skeleton
fields.tell: rattles back, raising its sword in both bony hands

fields.name: Cave Crab
fields.tell: opens its huge claw wide, aiming for your leg

fields.name: Thorn Sprite
fields.tell: bristles all over, every thorn pointed at you

fields.name: Hobgoblin
fields.tell: plants its feet and hauls back a spiked club

fields.name: Ghoul
fields.tell: unhinges its jaw, gathering itself to lunge

fields.name: Dire Wolf
fields.tell: lowers its head and gathers itself for a leap

fields.name: Bog Lurker
fields.tell: sinks low, ripples racing toward you through the water

fields.name: Vine Horror
fields.tell: coils every vine back like a drawn bowstring

fields.name: Orc
fields.tell: roars and swings a great axe up over its shoulder

fields.name: Troll
fields.tell: rips a slab of stone out of the wall and hoists it overhead

fields.name: Wight
fields.tell: draws the warmth from the room into one freezing claw

fields.name: Ghost
fields.tell: wails, and the air turns to grave-cold needles

fields.name: The Drowned Abbot
fields.tell: raises a censer that drips black water, chanting backwards

fields.name: The Goblin King
fields.tell: stands on his throne and hefts a sceptre made from a frying pan

fields.name: The Thornmother
fields.tell: draws every root in the room taut, ready to lash

fields.name: Palp Guard
fields.desc: An unnerving beast that somehow seems both human and alien.

fields.name: Rusty Sword
fields.desc: More rust than sword. It has opinions about tetanus.

fields.name: Hand Axe
fields.desc: A woodcutter's axe that took up a more exciting career.

fields.name: War Pick
fields.desc: Built for opening armor the way a can opener opens cans.

fields.name: Silvered Blade
fields.desc: Silver-chased steel. The undead hate it, which says a lot about the undead.

fields.name: Leather Jerkin
fields.desc: Smells like a cow that had a hard life.

fields.name: Chain Shirt
fields.desc: Jingles when you sneak. You will not be sneaking.

fields.name: Scale Hauberk
fields.desc: Overlapping scales from something you hope is extinct.

fields.name: Healing Potion
fields.desc: Red, fizzy, tastes like pennies. Restores 8 HP.

fields.name: Greater Healing Potion
fields.desc: The good stuff. Restores 16 HP.

fields.name: Stale Bread
fields.desc: Technically food. Technically a weapon. Restores 3 HP.

fields.name: Wheel of Cheese
fields.desc: A whole wheel. Beasts find it irresistible. Restores 6 HP.

fields.name: Smoke Bomb
fields.desc: Throw it, then leave dramatically. Guaranteed escape.

fields.name: Flask of Lamp Oil
fields.desc: Flammable, throwable, regrettable. Plants and trolls fear fire.

fields.name: Vial of Holy Water
fields.desc: Blessed by a priest who was mostly sober. The undead hate it.

fields.name: Bag of Marbles
fields.desc: Hundreds of tiny ankle-betrayers.

fields.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
fields.desc: Less lucky for the rabbit. Raises your Fate limit by 1 while carried.

fields.name: Barnacled Reliquary Key
fields.desc: Opens the Abbot's sanctum. Crusted with things that used to be alive.

fields.name: Greasy Throne-Room Key
fields.desc: Opens the Goblin King's throne cave. Sticky in a way you'd rather not investigate.

fields.name: Living Seed-Key
fields.desc: Opens the Heartwood. It occasionally sprouts.

fields.name: Superior Healing Potion
fields.desc: Liquid sunrise in a heart-shaped flask. Glows a little. Hums a little. Restores 24 HP.
